title: Design 3c: Get Local on the tokens
why: Jason's directive (design/css-theme-brand.md, Release 3, Get Local). Get Local's directory (directory/index.php) and the classic directory (directory/classic.php, still linked from the rail) on the shared tokens, layouts unchanged: Get Local keeps its own Find a business box and Refine row (decisions/0058 note, 2026-11-12). Result cards keep their anatomy (name in link brown, Link top right, 30px icon actions). Status colours: closed right now in the metadata colour, never red (red is for real faults); a business marked closed for good in Grounded Amber on its tint (darker text, 5.2:1). The classic directory's Tailwind amber moved to the palette (its Go buttons were white on amber, 3.2:1; now white on brand brown). Contrast: no failures at 390 or 1280 on either page in the harness.
